title: Universal Postal Union
definition: The Universal Postal Union (UPU), established by the Treaty of Bern in 1874, is a specialized agency of the United Nations that coordinates postal policies among member nations, forming the single postal territory for the reciprocal exchange of letter mail.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Civil Services Examination under Prelims (International Organizations, UN Specialized Agencies) and Mains GS Paper II (Global Governance, Multilateral Institutions affecting India's trade and logistics).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Universal Postal Union.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of International Relations and UN Specialized Agencies
